summary: Uptime chart of daily bars coloured by incidents, with today pulsing; hover or use the arrow keys to read a day's figures.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Service name in the header. Also seeds the generated history.

attributes.name: incidents
attributes.description: Comma-separated `daysAgo:kind` entries that force a day's status. `kind` is `down` for a partial outage; any other value means degraded. `0` is today.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Overrides the status pill. Defaults to today's status.

keyboard.action: Select the previous or next day, starting from today.
Select the first or last day.

accessibility: The canvas has `role="img"`, `tabindex="0"` and an `aria-label` with the average uptime, the number of days with incidents and a hint to use the arrow keys.
The day tooltip has `role="status"`, so the selected date and figures are announced.
Leaving the canvas or moving focus away clears the selection.
motion: With reduced motion the bars appear without rising in, today's bar does not pulse and the status dot ping is off.
notes: History is generated demo data: each day's status and uptime come from a hash of `name`. Only `incidents` and `state` override it; there is no attribute for real data.
The day count adapts to the width: one bar per 6px, between 20 and 90 days. All three attributes are observed; a change rebuilds the history and refreshes an open tooltip.

data.note: Daily status and uptime are generated from a hash of `name`; only `incidents` and `state` override them.
